rows.headline: The packet's own field map said this build MAKES the item (d) conviction election. The build withdrew it, correctly, on every fixture. The repair is to the record, not to the paper: the box is NOT marked, and marking it was refused on the merits.
rows.whyTHEBOXWASNOTMARKED: Item (d) is a sworn paragraph -- 'On (date) I was convicted of (offence) in violation of N.J.S.A. (statute)', with the final sentence, the incarceration type, and the dates incarceration, probation and fines were completed. SIX of those NINE cells have no held fact on this route, so the paragraph identifies no conviction, and a marked box over an unwritten paragraph is an assertion the packet cannot support. FIX105 withdrew the mark with the row and was right to. On this route there is a second reason: item (d) prints a state N.J.S.A. statute line that a municipal ordinance conviction does not have, and the ordinance-versus-disorderly-persons-versus-Title-39 classification is a self-help stop this packet names. The completeness contract anticipates exactly this in its own CR-180 note: a counter that can only be satisfied by guessing a legal conclusion is pressure to ship an unsafe filing. A raster is re-earnable; a pre-answered sworn election is not curable by disclosure.
rows.whatWasCHANGED: The field-map row for a PERMANENTLY withdrawn election -- one whose repeating-row group declares cells the family maps to no fact, so no fixture it can ever build will print the row -- is now emitted as decision 'refuse' with blankTreatment REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING, requiredBeforeFiling true, routeDetermined false, determinedByTheCaseNotTheRoute true, and a whyTheRouteCannotDetermineIt that names the row, the six cells with no held fact, and the ordinance-specific reason. determinedByTheCaseNotTheRoute is the completeness contract's own auditable exception and it requires the reason to be present and non-empty. The election also reaches the participant guide as the COURT'S OWN FORM prints it -- 'the election box beside “d.” — Petition for Expungement (Form A), item (d), delivered page 19' -- rather than as the bare AcroForm terminal name 'guilty', which is what the first cut of this repair produced and which tells a participant nothing.
rows.whichREPAIRSMOVEDBYTES: NO PDF BYTE MOVED. Both fixtures re-hash to the digests they carried before, and all 86 page rasters and both contact sheets are unchanged. Only the three records moved. reports/actual-writes.json also carries the two `pageCount: 43` lines the base builder adds on its own, which is staleness this rebuild incidentally cleared.

requiredOptionsMissing.andWHYTHATISNOTANULLREPAIR: The number is the same and the reading behind it is not. BEFORE, readFieldRows routed the non-refuse 'measured_route_selection' row into writes, so the election was never classified as a blank at all and the counter was STRUCTURALLY BLIND to it -- VF11 said so and measured the election on the pages instead. AFTER, the row is a classified refusal, the contract reaches it, and it lands on the auditable case-determined exception with its reason present. The counter now reads something. This lane did NOT change the counter's arithmetic and did not touch verify-packet-completeness.mjs.

rows.theGUARDTHATFIREDFORTHEWRONGREASON: REPORTED BECAUSE IT NEARLY PASSED AS A PROOF. The first version of this guard read `label` off report.selections. That array names its entries `control`; only the pre-draw list from measuredSelections names them `label`. Every entry therefore read undefined, the marked-set was empty for EVERY family, and the guard fired on nj_arrest_no_conviction-set -- whose `dismiss` election IS drawn on canonical, as its committed actual-writes.json shows with a full box rectangle. That was a broken guard producing a false finding, not a found defect, and the earlier nj_ordinance-set fire was worthless as proof because it would have fired whatever the bytes said. Corrected to read `control` with `label` as a fallback, after which nj_arrest_no_conviction-set PASSES and nj_ordinance-set still REFUSES. The guard is therefore proved to DISCRIMINATE, not merely to fail.
rows.whyTHEGUARDISGATEDPERFAMILY: Run host-wide it refuses nj_indictable_conviction-set, nj_disorderly_persons-set and nj_clean_slate-set outright. All three carry the identical false declaration -- `guilty` declared measured_route_selection, never marked -- for the identical reason, and all three are other lanes' to repair. checkOfficial asserts the live field map deep-equals the committed one, so enabling the repair for them without rebuilding them would leave their --check failing on families this lane may not touch. Turning a record defect in someone else's family into a build that cannot run is a worse outcome than the defect. nj_disorderly_persons-set was rebuilt to confirm it still builds under this lane's builder; it does, with only the pre-existing pageCount staleness.

rows.headline: A packet whose required first step is 'find out whether you need to file at all' was shipping the motion and not the step. Five obligations repaired; the participant is now told, before anything else, that the record may already have sealed and that filing then would be wrong.

whatWasCHANGEDPEROBLIGATION.SERVICE: A new '## Who must be served, and by when' section CARRIES two sentences word for word, on lines of their own: 'Serve the Attorney General and the charging police department at least ten days before the hearing, where a motion is filed.' and 'Where a motion to seal is filed, notice must be given to the Attorney General and the police department at least ten days before the hearing.' Both are read from the committed track registry AND the RI intake memo and printed only while the two agree. DC-33's own certification block reciting G.L. 1956 12-1-12.1(b)(1) is named. THE METHOD IS STATED AS NOT HELD: neither record says whether service is by hand or by mail, so the packet says so and names the division clerk's office as the authority, rather than inventing one.
whatWasCHANGEDPEROBLIGATION.SELF_HELP_STOP: A '## Where self-help ends' section carries all SIX committed selfHelpStopConditions word for word, opening with 'This packet is not legal advice, and no lawyer has reviewed your case in preparing it' and 'Stop and get help from a lawyer or a legal-services office before you sign, file or serve anything'. The registry and the intake memo are both read and must agree. The immigration condition is called a hard stop.
whatWasCHANGEDPEROBLIGATION.REPEATING_ROWS: The DC-33 charge table row 1 is declared to the host's existing row-integrity rule. Two of its three cells are unmapped on this route, so the row is withheld WHOLE on every fixture and the withholding is disclosed in the held-but-not-printed table with its reason. Separately, '1 Counts 1' and '3 Dispositions 1' were refused as classified_unwritable_by_role -- they are neither court, prosecutor, clerk, agency nor notary fields but the participant's own facts off the certified docket -- and are now declared REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING with readable identities ('1. Count(s) — charge table row 1, delivered page 2'), so they reach the blanks list as something a person can act on. Their printed captions on the form are a run of underscores and the guide no longer shows a participant a row of them.
